item.title: Watch: Late Mogan two-pointer sees Donegal snatch draw against Tribesmen
item.description: Peadar Mogan's two-pointer in the 69th minute ensured Donegal remain unbeaten in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League as they record a 0-20 to 1-17 draw with Galway in Ballyshannon this afternoon.

item.title: Mayo and Kerry secure Division 1 victories as Armagh move into drop zone with Monaghan
item.description: Goals from Jordan Flynn and Cian McHale were the difference as Mayo moved up to second in the Allianz Football League Division 1 table with a 2-17 to 0-22 victory over Armagh in Castlebar this afternoon.

item.description: Check out all of this afternoon's Allianz Football and Hurling League fifth round results below...

item.title: Cleary admits Rebels were 'beaten off the field'
item.description: Cork manager John Cleary was making no excuses after his side's 100% record in Division 2 of the Allianz Football League went up in smoke in Celtic Park.

item.title: McGeary returns to Tyrone fold
item.description: Tyrone have been handed a major boost ahead of the last two rounds of their Allianz Football League Division 2 campaign with the return of Kieran McGeary from his overseas travels.

item.title: 'He had a huge impact on the game'
item.description: Andy Moran was singing Kobe McDonald's praises for the second weekend in-a-row after the teenager made another impressive contribution off the bench for Mayo.

item.title: Cork debutants delight O'Connor
item.description: Ben O'Connor was full of praise for newcomers Paudie O'Sullivan, Barry Walsh and Hugh O'Connor after Cork made it four wins from four at Kilkenny's expense in Division 1A of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: McGuinness hails record-equalling Murphy after Donegal battle back
item.description: Jim McGuinness saluted Michael Murphy after he played a key role in Donegal's comeback against Galway.

item.title: Limerick suffer O'Donovan blow
item.description: Limerick are set to be without Darragh O'Donovan for the remainder of the Allianz Hurling League after he suffered a shoulder injury in yesterday's win over Offaly.

item.title: LGFA announced club championship Team of the Year
item.description: The LGFA have announced the AIB Ladies Gaelic Football Club Championship Team of the Year.
